```{r other genes}
unique(variants_ann_expiii$feature)
variants_ann_expiii[variants_ann_expiii$feature %in% c("gag", "pol", "tat", "rav", "vpu", "env", "vif") & 
    variants_ann_expiii$impact == "HIGH" & 
    variants_ann_expiii$allele_freq >= 0.05 & 
    variants_ann_expiii$passage <= end_psg, ]




```

```{r in-text numbers}

# for nef and vpr

variants_expiii_subset <- variants_ann_expiii %>%
                                filter(nchar(ref_allele) < 20 & nchar(alt_allele) < 20) %>%
                                mutate(mut_info_line = paste0(exp_line, "_", mut_info),
                                passage = as.numeric(as.character(passage)))s

vpr_var <- variants_expiii_subset[variants_expiii_subset$feature == "vpr" & 
    variants_expiii_subset$impact == "HIGH" & 
    variants_expiii_subset$allele_freq >= 0.5, ]

length(unique(vpr_var$mut_info))

nef_var <- variants_expiii_subset[variants_expiii_subset$feature == "nef" & 
    variants_expiii_subset$impact == "HIGH" & 
    variants_expiii_subset$allele_freq >= 0.5, ]


length(unique(nef_var$mut_info))

```
